home.title: Convert and edit files without leaving your computer
home.subtitle: No file is ever uploaded to the internet.
home.noOperations: There are no operations yet for: {categories}. They come in upcoming versions.

tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: External programs used by the app. Features that depend on a missing tool are disabled.

purpose.qpdf: PDF: merge, split, passwords and compression
purpose.pdfium: PDF: page rendering and text extraction

install.title: How to install
install.fedoraFfmpeg: Fedora's ffmpeg-free lacks some encoders. For the full FFmpeg, use RPM Fusion:
install.bundled: This tool ships with the app. If it was not found, reinstall the app.
install.windowsRequired: This tool ships with the installer. If it was not found, reinstall the app.
install.windowsOptional: Download the installer from the official site: {site}. Then click “Check again” or choose the executable.

output.label: Where to save converted files
output.sameFolder: In the same folder as the original
output.folderRequired: Choose the folder where files will be saved.

suffix.label: File name suffix
suffix.help: Example: photo-{suffix}.png. If the name already exists, a number is added. The original is never replaced.

concurrency.label: Jobs at the same time
concurrency.help: How many jobs can run in parallel.

videoConcurrency.label: Video jobs at the same time

timeouts.label: Maximum time per job
timeouts.help: In minutes. A job that takes longer is stopped.

errors.invalidFile: The file is damaged or in an unsupported format.
errors.tooLarge: The file or the result is too large.
errors.toolMissing: A required tool was not found.
errors.timeout: The job exceeded the maximum time and was stopped.

image.title: Images
image.subtitle: PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF and ICO. Everything is processed on your computer.
image.otherFiles: {n} file in the list is not an image and is left out of this screen. | {n} files in the list are not images and are left out of this screen.
image.noNewImages: No new image was added: the files are already in the list or are not images.
image.started: {n} job added to the queue. Follow it in the jobs panel. | {n} jobs added to the queue. Follow them in the jobs panel.
image.startFailed: One job could not be created | {n} jobs could not be created

crop.label: Crop
crop.description: Keeps only an area of the image.

unavailable.tooMany: At most {max} images at a time.
unavailable.unsupportedFormat: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP and TIFF ({name} is not).

invalid.quality: Quality must be a whole number from 1 to 100.
invalid.dimension: Use whole numbers from 1 to {max} pixels.
invalid.percent: The percentage must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
invalid.spacing: The gap must be a whole number from 0 to {max} pixels.
invalid.cropOutside: The area goes beyond the size of {name} ({width} × {height} px).

hints.jpeg: Best for photos. No transparency: transparent areas become white.
hints.png: Lossless with transparency. Best for screenshots and logos.
hints.webp: Lossless with transparency, usually smaller than PNG.
hints.gif: Up to 256 colours. Animations keep only the first frame.
hints.tiff: Lossless, used for printing and scanning.
hints.ico: Windows icon. Images larger than 256 px are scaled down.

quality.label: Quality
quality.help: Lower values give smaller files with more loss of detail. 85 to 92 is a good balance.

convert.metadataNote: The photo orientation is applied and the colour profile is kept. Data such as location and camera is not copied.

help.fit: keeps the proportions inside the width and height

crop.sameArea: The same area is cropped from every image.

compress.qualityHelp: Used for JPEG. Lower values give smaller files.
compress.help: PNG uses the strongest lossless compression. If the result is not smaller than the original, the original is kept.

strip.help: Removes location (GPS), camera model, dates, comments and thumbnails without recompressing the image. Orientation and colour profile are kept.

merge.matchSize: Match sizes (shrinks the larger ones, never enlarges)
merge.order: Images follow the order of the list. Use the arrows to reorder.

about.description: Converts and edits files on your computer: images today; PDF, video, audio, documents and other formats in upcoming versions.
about.privacy: No file leaves your computer. The app makes no network requests and has no telemetry, usage analytics or automatic updates.
